configurePresets.name: qt-6.11
configurePresets.description: Pins the Qt installed under /opt by the Qt online installer. Without this, find_package(Qt6 6.2) is also satisfied by the distro Qt (6.4.2 in /usr) and the chosen version depends on search order.

configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: This is also the .deb packaging preset: CMakeLists.txt bundles this build's own Qt 6.11 libraries/plugins into the package (see the Install rules section), rather than linking whatever Qt6 the distro ships.

configurePresets.name: system-qt
configurePresets.description: Builds against the distro Qt in /usr. No longer used for .deb packaging (see the release preset) -- kept only for reproducing/comparing the system-Qt-specific bugs documented in BUILDINFO.md's Known issues section.
